summary: Option B should be accepted as the binding process decision. It is consistent with the pre-existing staged recommendation in docs/literature/Kamin-2025.md §9.3, and the current decoy implementation state makes Option A materially higher-risk: qkdx/numerics/kamin_decoy_sdp.py still documents a simplified non-WL22 honest model, no dark counts, dim_B=2 with eta_1 calibration instead of explicit loss outcome handling, and grid-search/approximate tradeoff handling rather than Kamin-style Frank-Wolfe refinement. Deferring Phase B does not create a unique downstream Sub-Q4 blocker that Option A would remove, and the split is reversible because Phase B remains explicit and can be re-prioritized later without information loss. The main caveat is interpretive: Phase A is a valid proxy milestone under delegated scope authority, but it does not literally satisfy user 3b or the original S2.5 hard acceptance on its own.

issues.description: The ADR currently frames T2-Phase A as closing part of S2.5 and marks S2.5 hard acceptance as "partial-closed." That overstates compliance relative to the authoritative requirement in docs/RESEARCH_PLAN.md:308 and the user-3b mapping in docs/AUTONOMOUS_RESEARCH_PLAN_2026-04-21.md:17, both of which still point to decoy Fig.3 < 5% reproduction.
issues.suggestion: Rewrite Option B so T2-A is explicitly a proxy milestone only. Keep S2.5 hard acceptance open until T2-B completes, and describe the ADR as a delegated scope split rather than satisfaction of the original acceptance criterion.

issues.description: The Sub-Q4 rationale is directionally helpful but overstated. RESEARCH_PLAN §5.1 defines Sub-Q4 gap-shape work from TF-QKD Pareto lower bounds plus Sub-Q3 upper bounds; Kamin decoy Fig.3 is useful calibration, but not a formal prerequisite that Option A uniquely unlocks.
issues.suggestion: Reframe this point as Phase B being best bundled with later Phase-2 lower-bound benchmarking / Sub-Q3 comparison work, rather than as a hard Sub-Q4 dependency.

issues.description: The ADR's 1-2 week / 3-5 week estimates materially supersede the older T2 placeholder estimate of 3-5 days in docs/AUTONOMOUS_RESEARCH_PLAN_2026-04-21.md:86, but that update is only implicit.
issues.suggestion: Add one sentence stating that the deeper implementation audit supersedes the earlier estimate because the remaining Fig.3 gap is tied to WL22 modeling, dark counts, explicit loss handling, and tighter optimization machinery.

round_recommendation: Accept Option B as binding, then do a short doc-only cleanup so T2-A is labeled as a proxy milestone, not S2.5 closure, and the dependency / schedule rationale is stated more precisely.
